caption_L1: This area chart is named Number of suspects arrested for terrorism offences in the European Union (EU) from 2010 to 2019 , by affiliation. The y-axis measures Jihadist while the x-axis plots Year.
caption_L2L3: The word "jihadist" isn't the same as saying "terrorism suspects". The largest increase is from 2013 to 2015, where a high positive linear trend is shown, over tripling the number of suspects arrested each year. From 2015 to 2017 the rate stays pretty stable, and then 2017 to 2019 it drops quite quickly, by approximately a third.
